title: RunnerResult — app-owned contract
description: The result file the sandboxed runner sends on its one channel with the declared outputs: null when the task succeeded, or the kind of failure the runner saw and a bounded message. Untrusted: the sandbox adapter validates it, takes only declared outputs within the cap and hashes them itself; failures the runner cannot see (time, CPU, the output cap, a kill) are the adapter's to report.
